sources.title: Jais-2-8B-Chat · Models - modelscope.cn
sources.snippet: Jais-2-8B-Chat is a bilingual Arabic-English language model developed by MBZUAI, Inception, and Cerebras. Jais-2-8B-Chat Model is trained from scratch on Arabic and English data and is powered by a custom Arabic-centric vocabulary, it efficiently captures Modern Standard Arabic, regional dialects, and mixed Arabic-English code-switching.

sources.title: Jais 2: A Blueprint for Sovereign AI - cerebras.ai
sources.snippet: The Jais 2 chat application runs at 2,000 tokens per second, making it one of the fastest LLMs in the world. Jais 2 serves as a blueprint for sovereign AI, showing how nations can develop highly capable, culturally aligned models at lower cost, higher speed, and without the complexity of large GPU clusters.
